name: High Plains Raceway

source._doc: RE-SOURCED 2026-10-28 (ledger 0059): the FULL 2.55-mile course, the closed cycle of OSM highway=raceway ways at 93301 E US Hwy 36, Deer Trail CO, every one oneway=yes so OSM also records the direction (clockwise, as the July research found from the PCA turn guide / LapMeta). OSM now closes the north section — Ladder To Heaven ends on node 1454637805 inside Prarie Corkscrew — so the 110 m gap the July 2.00-mile build left out is mapped, not invented (L1). route.roads lists the ten ways in driving order by id; build_ring trims the Corkscrew at that node. Snapshot: data/osm.cache.json. Not in the lap: the 172 m unnamed cut-through 132189634 (the short course) and Pit Lane 289311751 (691 m, 9-25 m north of the front straight). Superseded: source/osm_fixes.json (the July 2.00-mile cycle) and source/high_plains.kml (the old fabricated trace).

route._roads_doc: High Plains Drifter, To Hell On A Bobsled, Ladder To Heaven, Prarie Corkscrew (from node 1454637805), Full West (the front straight), unnamed 289314485, Short North, Bikers Berm, Niagara, Dannys Lesson.
route._orientation_doc: S/F: the midpoint of the front straight (OSM 'Full West', 371 m at 101.7 deg, WSW->ENE), 39.73504,-103.89449 — the July research's 'mid front straight ~39.7350,-103.8946' (PCA turn guide), now on the real frame. Pit lane: OSM 289311751 on the NORTH side (driver's left).

_width_doc: Measured 2026-10-28 off NAIP (m_3910317_ne_13_060_20190913, 0.6 m px, USGS/USDA public domain), cross-profiles every 0.3 m over +-10 m of each station. Three layers on every straight: dark asphalt (NDVI -0.25) to ~+-4.2 m, a sharp bright, non-yellow peak at ~+-5 m (brightness 157-173 = a white edge line blurred by the 0.6 m pixel; paint over asphalt predicts ~175), then dry grass at once. Edge-line centres 10.2-10.6 m apart (Short North 10.2 / 10.6, Bobsled 10.5) -> 10.5 m (34 ft), +-0.6 m. The front straight is wider: lines at ~-6.3 / +5.4 -> ~11.7 m, pit wall concrete at +9..+12 m north, pit-lane asphalt from +13 m — NOT modelled (one constant width; width_overrides is parsed but nothing consumes it). Two cruder reads bracket this and were set aside: NDVI half-max 9.9 m (stops inside the white line), grass-yellowness half-max 12.3-12.9 m (runs into the blurred verge). Replaces the 12.0 m inherited from the fabricated config. Overlays: build/naip_width_check*.png. Ledger 0059.
